templates.subject: Love Banana / debut LP (Michael Barker recommended we get in touch)
templates.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Hope you're doing well. Reaching out from Sydney, Australia. I sing and play guitar in a garage pop / rock & roll five-piece called Love Banana.

Michael Barker (Gee Tee / RMFC) is putting out our debut album 'Any Direction' here in Australia on his label Ragnar Records, and he pointed us in your direction to see if you'd be interested in teaming up on an overseas physical release.

We're doing our digital release ourselves, but we're looking for an indie label partner to team up on a physical release (vinyl / tape) over your way. In Australia, Michael is pressing the records, sorting us with band copies for shows, and keeping the sales from the run. We'd love to do something similar over there to get the record into local shops and into people's hands.

The album has 13 tracks and was mastered by Mikey Young. We don't have a locked release date for the full album yet because we want to coordinate with our physical partners. The digital rollout starts with our first single "Seagull" dropping on September 16, followed by our second single "Fit For Motion" alongside an official music video.

On the live side, we're taking this global to back the record: we've already begun booking a European tour for October 2027, and we're currently putting together an American tour as well. Over here in Australia we've supported Ty Segall, Babe Rainbow, and Bananagun, and our debut 7" went to #3 on the Australian AIR indie charts.

You can stream the unreleased record and check out our links here:

Advance LP Stream: https://love-banana-epk.vercel.app/album.html
Lead Single ("Seagull" WAV Master): https://love-banana-epk.vercel.app/downloads/Love%20Banana%20-%20Seagull.wav
Band EPK: https://love-banana-epk.vercel.app/epk.html
Bandcamp: https://lovebanana.bandcamp.com/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lovebanarna/

Give the album stream a listen when you have a minute and let us know if you think this could be a fit for your roster. No stress either way, really appreciate your time.

Cheers,
Henry Collins
Love Banana
lovebananaband@gmail.com

outbox.subject: New Music from Sydney: Love Banana — "Seagull" (Mastered by Mikey Young)
outbox.body:
Hey Henry,

Hope you're well! Reaching out from Sydney, Australia. I play guitar and sing in a garage pop / rock and roll five-piece called Love Banana.

We're putting out the lead single "Seagull" from our debut album 'Any Direction' (coming out on Ragnar Records, mastered by Mikey Young). It's out on September 16, and thought it would be right up the alley for your station/publication.

Following our 7" which hit #3 on the Australian Independent Record Labels (AIR) charts and picked up radio spins on 4ZZZ, Triple R, and Radio Elance over in Spain, we'd love for you to give this new one a spin.

🎧 Full WAV Master: https://love-banana-epk.vercel.app/downloads/Love%20Banana%20-%20Seagull.wav
🎨 Artwork: https://love-banana-epk.vercel.app/downloads/Seagull%20-%20Artwork.png
📖 Full EPK & Stream: https://love-banana-epk.vercel.app/epk.html

If you fancy playing it on your station/publication or would like an exclusive station ident/shoutout, just let me know!

Cheers,
Henry Collins
Love Banana
https://lovebanana.bandcamp.com/

leads.notes: Boutique indie music blog celebrating DIY releases, interviews, and tape culture.

leads.name: BrooklynVegan Submissions
leads.guidelines: Pitch indie guitar, garage, and post-punk releases with streaming link and tour/album news.
leads.notes: Major independent music blog with dedicated Indie Basement column for garage pop.

leads.name: Raven Sings The Blues
leads.guidelines: Streaming links. High affinity for psych, garage, and Antipodean jangle/punk.
leads.notes: Essential reading for psych, garage, and underground record collectors.

leads.name: Post-Trash
leads.guidelines: Private Soundcloud or Bandcamp stream. Loves scuzzy DIY guitar rock and post-punk.
leads.notes: Influential underground DIY webzine. Dedicated to tape culture and fuzzy guitar riffs.

leads.name: Austin Town Hall
leads.guidelines: Direct stream link, release date, and high-res art. Huge fan of Australian garage & jangle pop.
leads.notes: Legendary indie/garage blog and tape label. Consistently champions Australian underground bands.

leads.name: Radio Campus Paris
leads.guidelines: Digital link submissions. Hub of the French student and indie music network.
leads.notes: Leading French campus station with heavy coverage of emerging international guitar bands.

leads.name: NTS Radio Submissions
leads.guidelines: Digital stream links only. Look for shows with post-punk, garage, and psych tags.
leads.notes: Global underground radio platform with dedicated post-punk, garage, and alternative shows.

leads.name: Soho Radio London
leads.guidelines: Include artist bio, social links, and private streaming link. High tastemaker profile.
leads.notes: Independent online and vinyl broadcast station based in Soho, London.

leads.name: WPRB Princeton
leads.guidelines: Links only. High appreciation for DIY punk, garage, and outsider pop.
leads.notes: Independent, non-commercial community radio broadcasting across NJ and Philadelphia.

leads.name: WCBN Ann Arbor
leads.guidelines: Freeform student station. Loves weird, wild, and fuzzy garage rock.
leads.notes: Famous freeform student radio with deep roots in Detroit rock and garage.

leads.name: KGNU Boulder & Denver
leads.guidelines: Digital links to 320kbps MP3s. Volunteer-run community radio.
leads.notes: Community radio powerhouse serving Denver and Boulder with eclectic programming.

leads.name: CiTR Vancouver
leads.guidelines: Digital submissions with bio, links, and track details. Publishes Discorder Magazine.
leads.notes: Pioneering Pacific Northwest campus station with tight ties to DIY garage scenes.

leads.name: CJLO Montreal
leads.guidelines: Digital submissions to music@cjlo.com with EPK, streaming link, and bio.
leads.notes: Consistently rated #1 campus radio station in North America by CMJ/NACC.

leads.name: WTUL New Orleans
leads.guidelines: Streaming links with downloadable 320kbps MP3s. Strong champion of international DIY garage pop.
leads.notes: Student-run non-commercial radio in New Orleans with an adventurous rock rotation.

leads.name: WFMU Music Programming
leads.guidelines: Stream links preferred. Completely independent freeform radio, zero commercial influence.
leads.notes: Longest-running freeform radio station in the US. Unmatched global tastemaker status.

leads.name: KXLU Music Directors
leads.guidelines: Streaming links or download links (no direct audio file attachments). Loves punk, garage, lo-fi, and DIY.
leads.notes: Heart of the Los Angeles underground garage and punk scene. Famous Demolisten show.

leads.name: KALX Music Department
leads.guidelines: Digital submissions accepted. Include streaming link and 320kbps MP3 download. Freeform programming.
leads.notes: Legendary Bay Area freeform college station. Heavy focus on underground and indie garage.

leads.name: KEXP Music Directorate
leads.guidelines: Send digital download links or stream links. High rotation for indie rock, garage, and international discoveries.
leads.notes: The premier indie station in North America. Huge supporter of Australian psych, garage, and indie rock.
